# 98.css

98.css 0.1.21 by Jordan Scales, MIT licence (see LICENSE).

- `98.css` is the upstream build, unchanged. Do not load it directly: it points at font files we do not ship.
- `zoble98.css` is what the site loads (through `shared.css`). It is generated by `node tools/build-98.mjs`: font faces and scrollbar rules removed, every selector scoped under `.z98`, colours swapped for Zoble 98 tokens.

The pixel font 98.css bundles is under a different licence and is not included. Zoble uses its own font, `zoble-98.woff2`.
